title: Rennell-Bellona Language (MNV)... | Ethnologue Free
text: Rennell-Bellona is a stable indigenous language of the Solomon Islands. It belongs to the Austronesian language family. The language is used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
